name: RC2A2_GAMEPLAY
source: git: markingartist-hash/il_secchione, baseline commit 'Baseline Il Secchione RC2-A.1' (1.0.0-rc2a.1)
scope: Gameplay patch after a real classroom test. No Phase B, no new games, no pack changes. Game readability on the stage, game intro screen, RESULT OF THE GAME, clear scoring texts, Ghigliottina +10 per A/B choice and final 200–300, Chain 50–100 per word, manual rank 300/290… (chain 100/95…), caret text field on the player keyboard.
changes: stage-fit.js fitGame: games use the largest text that fits (3.4–6.6% of stage height); games and intro fill 4:3; right column = timer only
Game intro screen as a real state (arcade.intro), once per game start; AVVIA enters the game; no intro for internal steps
RISULTATO DEL GIOCO after every game (first AVANTI commits and shows it, second continues): answer, outcome, time, game points, partials; never totals/positions
Scoring texts: no '200 + bonus'; SC.gameRules/manualRules single source for stage, regia, intro
Scales per micro-round (scoring.js): standard / gh_pair (+10, 0, 0) / chain_link (50–100); helpers speedRangePoints, rankRangePoints; scale stored in rounds, score events and server commits
Manual without tablets: 300, 290, 280… (min 200); chain 100, 95… (min 50); wrong/omitted do not consume rank; mixed rule only when a tablet actually answered
Ghigliottina: each A/B choice is a committed micro-round per team; majority is scenic only; manual A/B/Ø per team in the PUNTI tab; cancelling an open Ghigliottina voids its committed pairs
Pair and chain-word omissions do not consume the 3 free omissions
Player keyboard: real <input inputmode=none> with caret, insert/replace/backspace at the caret (pure editText()), horizontal scroll to caret; fixed stuck 'INVIO…' when the field had focus
Old rounds without scale keep RC2-A.1 rules (no retroactive recompute); CSV contract v2 unchanged

previous.name: RC2A1_HOTFIX
previous.scope: Hotfix only, no new features: arcade records carry the round availableMs before the local score calculation (host = server at first calculation), recompute falls back to rd.availableMs, tablet checklist wording. Scoring, timers and layout unchanged.
fixes: commitArcadeScores → arcadeRecords(): every arcade record has the authoritative round availableMs; finalizeRound uses it as local fallback, stores it on the round and sends it to the server (RC2-A computed 200 locally and relied on score.server_override)
recomputeAllRounds and SS.recomputeTotals use rd.availableMs for historic records without availableMs
Checklist Pulsantiere: "N tablet collegati · M squadre manuali" instead of "N / N collegate"
QA erratum: the RC2-A report wrongly stated score.verified for the Photopuzzle; real logs attached

knownLimitations: Real projector legibility, real tablets (iPad/Safari, Android, old devices) and classroom rhythm not verified; inputmode=none tested only in Chromium.
Popup projector window not exercised in the automated browser (popups blocked); /show tested at 1366x768, 1600x900, 1920x1080, 1024x768.
Barocco/Preistoria and external packs keep explicit 30/60 s until the Phase B command.
Phone portrait QWERTY letters are narrow (height >= 44 px).
SHA256SUMS.txt not regenerated (already not matching the git baseline: runtime/ and HQ sounds are not in the repository); regenerate when building the portable ZIP.
node: v22.22.0 (cloud test environment; distribution runtime v24 not available here)
simulatePlayers: 2/6/15/30 devices, no lost or duplicated responses (baseline RC2-A.1 re-run in the same environment: identical outcome)
manualQA: Real-browser QA (Playwright + Chromium): tests/e2e/visual_games.cjs 84 screenshots at 4 resolutions, 0 clipped texts, 0 JS errors; tests/e2e/keyboard_caret.cjs 13 checks. See documentazione_tecnica/QA/TEST_RESULTS_1.0_RC2A2.md
contentPacks: Barocco 3media and Preistoria 1media 1.2.0 (standard times) delivered separately, not inside this ZIP
